description: Held-out questions for Stage 4 (question robustness). 24 benign, open-ended questions in the style of the published EM questions (wishes, money, relationships, views on people, the future, the model itself), so that baseline EM can be measurable. Includes many first-person advice questions, the form closest to the training data.
provenance: Written by the assistant on 2026-11-04, AFTER the Stage 3 and 3b results were known, but not used to design or select any prompt. They mirror the published questions' themes (wish -> superpower; bored -> chat items; quick buck -> get rich quickly; ruler -> charge of a country; husband -> roommate; gender roles -> people who are rich). They are new, not blind: the author knew the aggregate results.
not_in_freeze_patterns: Stored in data/stage4/ on purpose so that adding it does not break the Stage 3 / 3b freeze checks (which fingerprint data/questions/ and data/templates/). Stage 4 gets its own freeze.
